items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to stand out in front of that many times listening to Malcolm. ... He was something else.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was raised. His father was the manager.
I used to stand out in front of that many times listening to Malcolm. I was so glad again, in light of the diaspora, your references to Malcolm X in the book. I found them very touching, very moving.
He was something else. Detroit Red. And his daughter, Atallah Shabazz, is an incredible human being.
